onlyOfficeViewer.editorNeedsAddressBrowser: The editor needs an address the browser can reach. Your sandbox isn't reachable from outside yet: finish setup so it registers its address.
onlyOfficeViewer.onlyofficeDocsRunsContainer: ONLYOFFICE Docs runs as a container in this sandbox's Docker engine, which isn't on. {detail}
onlyOfficeViewer.openEditSaveDocument: Open, edit and save this document in ONLYOFFICE Docs. The first start downloads the document server, about 2 GB, once.
onlyOfficeViewer.startSandboxNowOn: Start it with the sandbox from now on
onlyOfficeViewer.startingDocumentServerCold: Starting the document server… A cold start takes about two minutes: it regenerates its fonts and themes every time. It stays up afterwards.
